hero.title: Database benchmarking as a service
hero.lead: Describe what to test — Stroppy Cloud builds the stand, runs the load and keeps a result you can compare and share.

story.label: How a run goes

provision.title: A stand in your cloud
provision.body: Machines for the database and the load are created in your Yandex Cloud or AWS account — you pay the cloud directly.

deploy.title: The database sets itself up
deploy.body: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, YDB, CockroachDB, Picodata, OrioleDB — from one node to a cluster. The stand is checked before the load; transient failures are retried, and a real problem stops the run with a clear reason.

load.title: The load is live
load.body: While stroppy runs the scenario you see QPS, latency and errors, logs and metrics of every machine.

result.title: A place in the rating, a comparison
result.body: The run joins the public rating next to other configurations and is compared with your past runs. The stand is removed afterwards.

story.heading: How a run goes
story.sub: From the Launch button to a place in the rating — PostgreSQL 17 with Patroni on three nodes.

footer.about: Database load testing on stroppy — in your own cloud.

end.title: Your first run in a few minutes
end.lead: Connect a cloud, pick a database and a scenario — Stroppy Cloud does the rest.
